answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay makes fakes costly to keep. Each new identity needs an established sponsor staking 100 credits; idle reputation decays 5 per epoch unless work restores it. Every sponsorship echoes publicly, exposing farm clusters; sponsor rental collapses on a ledge: one confirmed fake pushes the sponsor off, slashing the stake. The k-th fake still needs a fresh sponsor and 100-credit stake, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits, bleeding 5,000 per idle epoch. A comet flash sustains nothing; one honest agent pays one stake and keeps its full share.
